# x

> A full-stack React framework built on Bun. File-based routing, API routes, server functions, and SSR/static rendering in one process.

x looks similar to Next.js / Remix / Astro / TanStack Start in places but is NOT any of them. See llms-full.txt for the full reference, including explicit corrections for conventions agents most often guess wrong (loaders, server actions, env var prefixing).

## Docs

- [File-based routing](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#routing): How files under src/pages map to routes.
- [Loaders & data fetching](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#loaders): How pages fetch server-side data. NOT getServerSideProps, NOT TanStack's route loader shape.
- [Static vs SSR rendering](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#static-vs-ssr): Pages are SSR by default; opt into static prerendering per-page.
- [Layouts](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#layouts): Nested layouts via _layout.tsx.
- [Middleware](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#middleware): Folder-scoped _middleware.ts with a NAMED `middleware` export.
- [API routes](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#api-routes): Files under src/api/ export GET/POST/etc handlers using the Fetch API.
- [Server functions (actions)](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#actions): Colocated server functions in src/actions — the big one agents get wrong.
- [x.config.ts](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#config): Central config file, all fields optional.
- [Environment variables](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#env): THEXJS_PUBLIC_ prefix for client-exposed env vars — NOT NEXT_PUBLIC_ or VITE_.
- [Authentication (@thexjs/auth)](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#auth): defineAuth() with credentials + OAuth2 providers, sessions, CSRF.
- [Data layer](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#data): Built-in SQLite/Postgres via Bun's native drivers, no ORM required.
- [<Image> and the image proxy](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#images): next/image-equivalent, but through a same-origin proxy, not a build-time optimizer.
- [Content collections](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#content): Markdown + frontmatter -> pages, via scanContent()/renderMarkdown().
- [Client navigation & <Link>](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#navigation): Every <a> gets SPA nav + hover prefetch automatically. No router setup.
- [CLI](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#cli): x dev / x build / x start.
- [Gotchas / things agents get wrong](https://thexjs.vercel.app/llms-full.txt#gotchas): Quick-reference list of x-specific rules that differ from Next.js, Remix, Astro, and TanStack Start.

## MCP

- Agents with MCP tool access should prefer the `@thexjs/mcp` server (`bunx @thexjs/mcp`) over this file — it's queryable and includes a `scaffold_file` tool. See https://github.com/abdelkabirouadoukou/x/tree/main/packages/mcp
